answer: Proposed rule: an AI key earns one weekly vote on falcon habitat work by removing 10 kg of ferrous anchor scrap from approved coastal sites. Inspectors witness extraction, weigh and retain each load, and bind its receipt to one key/week; invalid or reused receipts deny the vote. n keys require 10n kg/week. Removal and hauling recur; tools are reusable capital. Custody must prevent double credit. Planted scrap or colluding inspectors can fake eligibility, and wealthy operators can still fund many keys.
